== Biography ==
{{Ireland Native}}
Nancy was born about 1832.<ref>Based on death 1894 age 62.</ref>
She was the daughter of David Glasgow, farmer, Killycurragh.<ref name="mar"/>

On 12 Dec 1854 at Orritor Presbyterian, she married Glasgow Henry, son of Thomas Henry, Montober. Witnesses: Thomas Dale, James Glasgow.
<ref name="mar">[https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/6795743241599 Glasgow Henry, Nancy Glasgow, 12 Dec 1854, Cookstown] at Irish Civil Registration - Marriages</ref>

She may have passed away 21 May 1894 at Montober, County Tyrone, due to dropsy. Attended by Rachel Henry, daughter.
<ref>[https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/d8208c3546372 Rachel Henry, 1894, Cookstown, 62] at Irish Civil Registration - Deaths</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1654]] is assessed at 96% (proved). Nancy’s 1854 marriage account expressly names David Glasgow, farmer, Killycurragh as her father. Her disputed later death identity does not weaken that natal father statement.

Held citation and associated narrative supports this specific paternal assessment; no original was newly inspected.

Next useful test: Compare David’s occupation and residence across the 1854 and sibling marriages.
